snippet.title: Dream Ball - Giant Trackball Redemption Video Game
snippet.description:
Can you beat the clock? Guide your ball across the course using the giant trackball controller to win redemption tickets before the time runs out. Master the different obstacles as you play against a friend or the computer players.

Operate in ticket redemption mode, or play just for fun. Ultra modern white cabinet design with great LED lighting.

More details on UDC website here: https://www.udc.co.uk/dream-ball
